data.firstScreenText: About Hey, I’m Wint Khant Lin, also known as Happer. I’m a college student from Myanmar who’s deeply passionate about software engineering, especially backend systems, distributed architectures, and building tools that solve real problems.I started coding because I was curious about how things work under the hood. That curiosity turned into a love for over-engineering side projects, exploring system design, and learning in public.
